units.titles: Requirements violation: Free minting does not verify freelisted users
units.known_address_notes: iRocket AR / 'The NeoGen' ERC-721, Hacken audit Aug-2022, repo iRocket-io/NEOGEN-contract (now deleted). irocket.io is dead, the Hacken page is Cloudflare-gated with no address in the mirrored PDF, and the moon.ly collection page (43 KB JS shell) exposes no contract address. No Etherscan name search exists and the NFT-marketplace APIs available here (OpenSea) reject the stored key with 401. PARTIAL: project identity resolved, deployment unpublished.

units.titles: H-01. The same signature can be used in different distribution implementation allowing unauthorized distributions
units.known_address_notes: Sparkn (CodeFox Inc), Cyfrin contest Aug-2023, scope ProxyFactory/Distributor/Proxy. Both repos were enumerated: they contain src + script only, no broadcast/, deployments/ or address constants; HelperConfig defines token addresses for Polygon (137) and Avalanche (43114) but no factory address, and DeployContracts reads the factory admin/tokens from env vars. sparkn.io is dead and its archived frontend fetched addresses from a backend. PARTIAL: audited code and chains known, factory/distributor

units.titles: Unpaid validators can getting paid and deny unsubscribe() right of paid validators
units.known_address_notes: Same project/target as P25-0015 (Metatime Genesis Contracts on MetaChain, chain 571); this unit's finding F-2023-0929 is in the same MinerPool/validator payout code. No address is published: the repo's only committed address is the BSC MTC token, and MetaChain's RPC (rpc.metatime.com) answers Cloudflare 403 while explorer.metatime.com is offline. PARTIAL, duplicated evidence recorded per unit.
